restaurant_name: บ้านฟอฟันคลินิกทันตกรรม
text:
It's unbelievable that getting dental treatment using the universal healthcare scheme (Gold Card) – completely free of charge – could result in such excellent service! 🥰😊🌹
If you're looking for a dental clinic participating in the Gold Card scheme, I highly recommend this one.
1. The staff provides excellent service, and the registration process is easy.
2. The dentist is cheerful, friendly, and speaks very kindly. They gave advice after the check-up about what needed to be done.
3. During the treatment, the dentist worked calmly, unhurriedly, and meticulously.
I highly recommend this clinic for anyone looking for a dental clinic using the Gold Card scheme.
🥰🥰🥰
P.S. The clinic doesn't have parking. I recommend parking in the 7-Eleven parking lot next to the clinic and walking over. It's not far.

After I quit my job, my social security benefits expired, so I used my gold card. When I learned that this clinic accepted my gold card for dental treatment, I decided to give it a try.

I can tell you, I wasn't disappointed. I used my gold card to have my teeth cleaned. The dentist also polished my teeth and applied fluoride. The female dentist was very gentle and polite.
